items.q: "La Mer," yeah, the old Charles Trenet tune, which was also the thing Bobby Darin made a hit on as “Beyond the Sea,” back in the 50s.

ctx.x: “La Mer,” yeah, the old Charles Trenet tune, which was also the thing Bobby Darin made a hit on as “Beyond the Sea,” back in the 50s. We didn’t do it that way though, we did it more a traditional way.
